title: Record M0 and M0.5 completion status in PLAN.md and README
requirements: In PLAN.md §10 Roadmap add an explicit status marker line directly under the M0 — Skeleton and M0.5 — Self-Hosting headings, in the form '**Status:** done — <evidence>' or '**Status:** partial — <what remains>', with concrete evidence references (make demo, telegram gateway, planner, task QA, peak policy, sandbox).
Do not delete or renumber existing roadmap items; only add status markers and, where a stated deliverable is missing, list it under 'partial' with the remaining item.
In README.md update the '**Status:** pre-alpha' section to name M0 and M0.5 as complete (or partial with the same wording as PLAN.md) and link to PLAN.md §10.
Keep the wording in English (D-025) and factual: do not claim a state that the repository does not show.

Add tests/test_docs_status.py, a unittest that reads PLAN.md and README.md from the repository root and asserts: under each of the '### M0 — Skeleton' and '### M0.5 — Self-Hosting' headings there is a '**Status:**' line, and README.md contains the same M0/M0.5 status wording.
acceptance: tests/test_docs_status.py exists and passes, proving PLAN.md has a Status line under both the M0 and M0.5 roadmap headings and README.md carries the matching status.

The repository documentation claims only evidence that exists in the tree (make demo target, telegram module, planner module, task QA, peak policy, sandbox); a human confirms each claim is backed by a file or Makefile target.
constraints: Documentation-only change plus one test file; do not change product code.
Do not mention internal working documents or sessions in the text.
plan_goal: Довести проект до выхода на M1 (публичная OSS-альфа): вертикальный срез Django/DRF + React SPA + Postgres + S3 на Yandex Cloud, multi-repo, независимый e2e QA в изолированном стенде, staging с подтверждением человеком, учёт стоимости и приёмок, самохостинг Forgel на самом себе. Первой задачей — проставить в PLAN.md и README отметки о том, что из M0/M0.5 уже сделано, чтобы список отражал реальность.

checks.criterion: PLAN.md has Status lines under M0 and M0.5 and README.md matches
Every status claim is backed by an existing file or Makefile target
